cohort: The study included hypoxic infants born at >=34 weeks of gestation with transient tachypnea of the newborn (TTN) who received primary noninvasive respiratory therapy.
finding: Comparing CPAP with NC as initial noninvasive respiratory therapy for TTN, significantly lower maximum FiO2 was observed in the infants of the CPAP group without an increase in the incidence of pneumothorax.
